import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct');S=pathlib.Path('/workspace/Math-curvature-20261026/frontiers/source_derivative_gaussian_20261025/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')
old=S.read_text();a="  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,\n    smul_eq_mul, d0, d1, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]\n  ring";assert old.count(a)==1;new=old.replace(a,"  change -Real.sin (Real.pi * (Q Y) 0) * (Real.pi * (Q V) 0) +\n    2 * (-Real.sin (Real.pi * (Q Y) 1) * (Real.pi * (Q V) 1)) = _\n  ring")
H=B/'history/production-fixtures-fix003';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);orig=H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL';orig.write_text(old);S.write_text(new)
p=B/'PRODUCTION_FIXTURES_FIX003_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/production-fixtures-fix003/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL',tofile='SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')))
cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text());prior=cache[str(S)];st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact prior source ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
st=p.stat();cache[str(p)]={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST new actual full patch identity, once'};cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only fixtures003 deprecated CLM simp names and equivalent coerced-Q ring atoms','full_patch':str(p)}))
